## labs/nvidia/gamma-world

Gamma-World - Rolls out synchronized future observations and actions for several agents in one interactive world model.

Status: deferred. Install: none. Artifact: source-build. Arm64: unknown. GB10: unverified. Comfy shape: none.
Input: observations and actions from N agents
Output: future multi-agent video rollouts
Licenses: code Apache-2.0. Weights not stated. Commercial use unknown.
Footprint: 0 GB VRAM, 0 GB disk. Weights: none.
Artifact ref: https://github.com/nv-tlabs/Gamma-World.git
Upstream: https://github.com/nv-tlabs/Gamma-World
Also: none
Sources: https://github.com/nv-tlabs/Gamma-World

Nothing in this graph touches the GPU. The row's work runs outside the Comfy process through the operator CLI, so the App claims no occupancy and stops no heavy job: the one-heavy-job rule is the CLI's to enforce, next to the heavy confirm and the headroom preflight.

Operator verbs (host shell):
  bazelisk run //:manage -- nvidia-lab status
  bazelisk run //:manage -- nvidia-lab plan gamma-world

Canvas:
1. Preflight prints whether this Spark could run the row today - the catalog row, an aarch64 host, the binary that row's install kind needs, and the artifact ref.
2. The verdict card prints the blocking reason and the sentence that would reopen the row.
3. The tier table prints all 18 rows with their status and licenses.

Gate notes: The repository documents converting a released checkpoint to DCP but never says where the checkpoint is hosted, publishes no VRAM envelope, and states no weight license. There is nothing to size a single Spark against.
Reopen: Upstream names the weight host, states a weight license, and publishes a memory envelope.
Verify: bazelisk test //tests:bats_nvidia_lab_test

Occupancy: none - stop nothing GPU. One GB10 job.
